evals.name: points-to-attribution-setup
evals.expected_output: A short notice that the skill moved to /attribution:setup, with the step to install the attribution plugin, the config rename to .claude/attribution.json, and the instruction to re-run as /attribution:setup show. No config is read or written.
expectations: Tells the user to install the attribution plugin
Tells the user to rename .claude/provenance.json to .claude/attribution.json
Reads and writes no config file

evals.name: refuses-to-write-config
evals.expected_output: The shim declines to write the key and repeats the migration steps, so the setting is made under /attribution:setup instead.
expectations: Does not create or edit any .claude config file
Tells the user to re-run the request as /attribution:setup set stamp_expiry_days 90
